why_it_matters: So far the pointer directions are necessary, and sufficient when taken from each scene's own change; neither shows an address the model reads by (Dan).

hypotheses.H-batch44: Dan's batch 44 (Q44.1-Q44.4), predictions/2026-10-26_dan.md, committed before any result is opened

decision_rule: Fixed in advance (batch 44): Q44.1 at s = 1 the target share minus the random direction's >= 0.15 with lower CI > 0; Q44.2 among writes that move the lookup to another locker target / (target + third) >= 0.80, a model counting only with >= 30 such writes, fewer than two counting = can't tell; Q44.3 target minus random >= 0.10 in each of the 6 (j, k) pairs; Q44.4 (the 9B, B) order / sentence index / distance by which variant shifts (mean beta >= 0.5, lower CI > 0); each over the 9B, the 27B, the 122B and Muse. Gate and eligibility as the routes test (the 122B at 0.75, after the data). Cluster bootstrap over bridge items, 10,000 resamples, seed 0.
